Control the behavior of the backdrop when the Modal is visible.- 'interactive': The backdrop will be rendered and will allow user interactions on the backdrop itself.

properties.name: subscribe
properties.comment: Subscribe to overlay state changes. The provided listener function will be called whenever there is a change in the overlay state, such as when an overlay is shown, updated, or dismissed. The function returns an unsubscribe function that can be called to stop listening for changes.

properties.name: getState
properties.comment: Get the current state of all overlays. This method returns an array of overlay nodes, each representing an active overlay in the system.

properties.name: has
properties.comment: Check if an overlay with the specified ID exists.

properties.name: id
properties.comment:
Unique identifier for the overlay node.This is used internally to manage the overlay stack and should not be provided by the user.
The `show` method will return the generated id when an overlay is shown.

properties.name: type
properties.comment:
Type of the overlay, this can be used to categorize the overlaysno default styles or behavior are attached to the type, it's just for categorization and easier management of the overlays
except for dismissLast method which can dismiss the last overlay of a specific type

properties.name: content
properties.comment: The content of the overlay

properties.name: contentStyle
properties.comment: Custom styles for the overlay content

properties.name: top
properties.comment: The absolute position from the top of the screen where the overlay should appear.

properties.name: left
properties.comment: The absolute position from the left of the screen where the overlay should appear.

properties.name: withBackdrop
properties.comment: Whether to show a backdrop behind the overlay.If true, the backdrop will be rendered and its behavior will be determined by the `backdropBehavior` property.

properties.name: backdropBehavior
properties.comment:
Control the behavior of the backdrop when the overlay is open- interactive: allows interaction with the backdrop
- block: won't allow any interaction with the backdrop and won't trigger onDismiss when the backdrop is pressed
- dismiss: will trigger onDismiss when the backdrop is pressed but won't allow any interaction with the backdrop

properties.name: dismissOnBackPress
properties.comment: Control whether the overlay should be dismissed when the back button is pressed on Android

properties.name: scope
properties.comment: Optional scope for grouping overlays.This can be used to dismiss all overlays within the same scope using the `dismissScope` method.

properties.name: duration
properties.comment: Duration in milliseconds after which the overlay will be automatically dismissed.

properties.name: onDismiss
properties.comment: Callback function that is called when the overlay is dismissed.

properties.name: animationConfig
properties.comment: Custom animation configuration for the overlay.This allows you to define custom enter and exit animations for the overlay.

properties.name: animationDriver
properties.comment:
Custom animation driver for the overlay. This is a function that takes an Animated.Value and returns an Animated.CompositeAnimation.If `renderAnimated` is provided, this driver will be used to control the animation of the overlay.
If not provided, the default fade in/out animation will be used.

properties.name: renderAnimated
properties.comment:
Custom render function for the overlay content with animation support. This allows you to have full control over the rendering and animation of the overlay.If this is provided, the `animationDriver` will be used to control the animation of the overlay, and the `content` property will be ignored.
The render function receives an object with the following properties:

properties.name: node
properties.comment: Node properties used to render the overlay content and control its behavior.

properties.name: stackIndex
properties.comment: The index of the overlay in the stack, used to calculate zIndex
